tasks.short: Select, clean and install arbor components

steps.what: Select spacers, rubber sleeves or cutters matching the approved setup
Clean selected spacers, sleeves or cutters and check their condition
Install components on arbors and check seating and security under safe setup procedures

tasks.design: Retain component selection, cleaning and installation with the setter. Approved instructions may already be available in {DOCS}; a digital instruction view alone does not remove handling, condition checks or secure mounting.
tasks.previous_blocker: This task consists of physical selection, cleaning and mounting, with equipment-specific safety checks.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software change replaces the physical actions described.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising damaged or unsuitable components and confirming correct seating.
tasks.human_edge: Hands-on inspection and judgement about fit and condition.
tasks.altitude: No change to setup time or operating authority.

reach.task: Escalate a damaged component or unclear setup instruction
reach.learn: Tooling acceptance criteria and safe escalation

evidence.claim: Keeping arbor component selection, cleaning and installation manual is an E1 design judgement; the digest's monitoring and calculation products do not establish automation of this physical task.

assumptions: Boundary is the setter's component selection, cleaning and installation, including immediate condition and mounting checks; programming, machining and production records are separate tasks.

Existing authorised setup planning supplies machine identity, component requirements and assembly instructions. The setter identifies and checks the actual parts during fully retained s1; missing specifications require clarification rather than inference.
The setter performs required isolation checks within retained setup time. No structured tool inventory, robotic handling or automatic component recognition is assumed.
No new configuration is proposed, so a native system change is unnecessary. Existing system runtime earns no labour saving; zero incremental upkeep follows from making no change.
research_questions: Is any separately measurable instruction-search burden present beyond this physical task?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100; R=25+30+45=100; gross=0, upkeep=0, net=0. Physical selection, cleaning and installation remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Physical setup and safety responsibility remain unchanged.
reach: Clarify tooling defects with production supervision
role.ambitious_version: Improve setup consistency through existing instruction and escalation practice without claiming a software labour saving.

job.title: Cutting, Punching, and Press Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
